summary.headline: VMS TMT Q4 FY26 revenue INR241 crore, net profit INR2.29 crore; FY26 revenue INR840 crore and PAT INR21 crore.
summary.overview: Management reported Q4 FY26 total revenue of INR241 crore, EBITDA of INR11.94 crore and net profit of INR2.29 crore, with FY26 revenue of INR840 crore, EBITDA of INR62.31 crore and net profit of INR21 crore. Management credited the CCM/hot-charging billet integration for lower raw material cost and about INR1,000-1,500 per ton of margin improvement. Borrowings were repaid during the year, and a 15 MW captive solar project is being commissioned in tranches. Management said no capacity expansion is currently planned, and utilisation is about 70-75% for both billets and TMT.

financial_highlights.change: Reheating cost of INR1,500-2,000/ton eliminated after CCM plant

segments.name: TMT bars
segments.commentary: Core and only product line; sold under Kamdhenu brand in Gujarat at about INR1,500/ton premium over regional brands. Gujarat market about 4.5-5 lakh tons a year; company sells about 15,000 tons per month.

segments.name: Billets (integrated)
segments.commentary: Company now makes its own billets from scrap via CCM and hot charging; stopped buying billets externally. Scrap bought at about INR35,000/ton versus INR42,000/ton earlier billet purchase price. Utilisation about 70-75%.

guidance_outlook: Management expects FY27 growth to be strong, with full-year benefit of the integration margin (about INR1,500/ton) and solar power.
Solar savings guided at about INR5 crore annually from 15 MW plant; INR5-6 crore saving in power bill over the half year cited in Q&A.
No expansion currently planned; management will announce if decided. Expansion would be within existing premises, which has permissions for up to 3 lakh tons.
Management says it will fund any future expansion from internal accruals over the next 2-3 years.
capex_capacity: 15 MW captive solar project, estimated cost about INR45-50 crore; 12 MW commissioning in June 2026 and remaining 3 MW about two months later (August-September, depending on rains).
Permissions for up to 3 lakh tons of TMT and billet production at existing premises; environment clearance obtained; land of 15-20 acres with space available.
TMT capacity utilisation about 70-75% of installed capacity; billet utilisation about 70-75%.
Management says no new capacity expansion is in plan currently.
Solar payback stated at five years.
demand_pricing: Dealer network above 227 dealers under three Gujarat distributors (allocated region-wise); dealer count to rise as new dealers are appointed, distributors fixed at three.
Festive season orders of about 10,000 MT; dispatch about 500 tons per day over roughly 20 days, with orders served within 24 hours.
Management says prices fell somewhat in the last two months, but raw material (scrap) prices fall the same day, so scrap-to-TMT conversion spread is unchanged.
Company covers raw material on the same day it sells TMT (e.g., 1,000 tons sold means 1,000 tons of scrap bought), limiting price risk.
Fleet of 50 trucks; dealers receive turnover discounts quarterly and incentives; company focused on Gujarat only.
Management cited infra demand drivers: high-rise approvals (60 floors), bridges, government projects, and the 2030 Commonwealth Games in Gujarat.

qa_highlights.question: What tangible benefits from the billet facility on raw material cost and margins?
qa_highlights.answer: Billets previously bought at about INR42,000/ton; scrap now about INR35,000/ton, and reheating cost of INR1,500-2,000/ton is eliminated, giving INR1,000-1,500/ton margin improvement carried through FY27.

qa_highlights.question: Solar project cost, timeline and savings?
qa_highlights.answer: Cost about INR45-50 crore; 12 MW commissioning this month and 3 MW in about two months; INR3/unit savings, about INR5 crore a year.

qa_highlights.question: Is capacity expansion planned over the next two-three years?
qa_highlights.answer: No expansion currently planned; existing premises permit up to 3 lakh tons and space exists for brownfield expansion if required.

qa_highlights.question: Is there pricing pressure in the market?
qa_highlights.answer: Prices fell somewhat in the last two months, but scrap prices fall the same day, so conversion spread is unchanged according to management.

qa_highlights.question: What is the working capital cycle after billet facility commissioning?
Current capacity utilisation for billet and TMT?
qa_highlights.answer: Both around 70-75% of installed capacity, with scope to improve.

risks_watch: TMT is a commodity; daily price swings and recent West Asia war supply disruptions were flagged by management as risks.
Recent softening in finished TMT prices over the last two months; pass-through to scrap assumed to hold.
Solar commissioning timing dependent on rains for the final 3 MW (August-September).
Q4 net profit of INR2.29 crore on INR241 crore revenue implies thin quarterly margins; watch EBITDA and PAT margin trajectory in FY27.
Single-product, single-state (Gujarat) concentration; management stated no plans to expand beyond Gujarat.
Call audio quality was poor; some answers were unclear, so certain figures (e.g., dealer productivity, ROE/ROC targets) were not quantified.
summary.management_tone: Confident on margins and FY27 growth, citing integration savings and solar. Evasive or vague on dealer productivity, ROE/ROC targets and the long-term capital plan, where answers were general and unquantified.
key_quotes: After the CCM plant and hot charging has been incorporated, now we are procuring raw material in form of scrap from across the world, and the cost of raw material has gone down.
So, whenever we sell any material in the market that is a TMT, so we cover our raw material on the same day.
We do not delay our purchase.

adds.what: 15 MW captive solar project (power, not production capacity)

growth.why: Management expects strong FY27 growth, backed by the CCM/hot-charging integration margin of about INR1,000-1,500/ton and solar savings of about INR5 crore a year, but gave no revenue growth figure and no new capacity; no expansion is planned, and utilisation is 70-75%.
